-            });
-
-        // similar to the above case but without the main class name. The classes
-        // should be loaded from the archive.
-        TestCommon.run("-Xlog:class+load=trace",
-                       "-cp", jars,
-                       "--module-path", moduleDir.toString(),
-                       "-m", MAIN_MODULE)
